name: Crownfall Tactics placeholder audio manifest
notes: Single manifest for ALL game audio. Every entry lists a local file plus the placeholder source it stands in for. To ship original audio, replace the files (or remap the file fields) — no code changes needed. If a file is missing or undecodable, the engine falls back to synthesized WebAudio placeholders so the game stays playable.
